title: Switch RMS language to English using the top-right language selection icon
summary: Use the RMS top-right language selection control (third icon from the right) to switch the interface from Chinese to English when the default login language appears in Chinese.
when_to_use: Use when you log into the Geek+ RMS web application and the default UI language appears in Chinese.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the UI language switch in the RMS application using the top-right language selection icon and confirm the UI text changes to English.
access_or_tools_needed: Top-right language selection control (third icon from the right)

visual_references.description: RMS home screen context showing the top-right language selection and that the third icon from the right switches language to English.

steps.title: Open the RMS application and locate the top-right language selection icon
steps.purpose: Identify the correct UI control used to change the RMS interface language.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS application and look at the top-right corner for the language selection control (the third icon from the right).
steps.expected_result: You can visually identify the top-right language selection control and confirm it is the third icon from the right.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS home screen is visible and the top-right language selection icon is present.
steps.failure_condition: The top-right language selection icon is not visible or you cannot determine which icon is the third from the right.

actions.label: Locate language icon
actions.exact_action: Look at the top-right corner for the language selection control (third icon from the right).

steps.title: Switch the RMS UI language from Chinese to English
steps.purpose: Change the RMS interface language to English when the UI is currently displayed in Chinese.
steps.instruction: If the UI is in Chinese after login, click the third icon from the right (the language selection). Then select/switch the language to English using the language selection control.
steps.expected_result: The RMS interface language switches from Chinese to English.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS UI text changes from Chinese to English after using the language selection control.
steps.failure_condition: Clicking the third icon does not change the language from Chinese to English.

actions.label: Click third icon from the right
actions.exact_action: Click the third icon from the right (language selection).

actions.label: Select English
actions.exact_action: Switch the language to English using the language selection control.

stop_or_escalate_if: If clicking the third icon does not change the language, stop and escalate to support (the source does not provide further troubleshooting steps).

steps.title: Verify the RMS UI text changes to English
steps.purpose: Confirm the language change took effect.
steps.instruction: Verify the RMS UI text changes from Chinese to English.
steps.expected_result: RMS interface language is displayed in English (not Chinese).
steps.healthy_condition: Visible UI labels/buttons are in English.
steps.failure_condition: UI text remains in Chinese after the language switch attempt.

actions.label: Confirm UI language
actions.exact_action: Verify the RMS UI text changes from Chinese to English.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the UI text does not change to English, stop and escalate to support.

success_criteria: RMS interface language switches to English instead of Chinese.
healthy_conditions: Top-right language selection icon is present on the RMS home screen.
After switching, RMS UI text is displayed in English.
failure_conditions: Language does not change from Chinese to English after clicking the third icon from the right.
escalation_guidance: If clicking the third icon does not change the language, stop and escalate to support (no further troubleshooting steps are provided in the source).

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Top-right language selection control; confirm it is the third icon from the right.

image_refs.what_to_look_at: Top-right language selection control; confirm it is the third icon from the right.

missing_details: The source does not provide the exact language dropdown/label text for selecting English; verification is limited to observable UI language change.
